releaseNotes:
Cookie for Windows 1.1.0 Official Release

- Full feature parity with macOS companion
- Transparent desktop companion with pixel-perfect character rendering
- Cursor interactions, pet reactions, and 5 expressive emotes
- Window climbing, jumping, and dynamic taskbar exploration
- Active application awareness and autonomous behaviors
- Native notification area system tray integration
- Single-instance protection and graceful activation
- Local settings persistence with corrupt recovery
- Privacy-first design: 100% offline local companion
